overview: The Watchtower Ring is the fortified perimeter of Sanctus Seru, staffed by Praetorian sentries and arcane surveillance specialists.
history: Constructed during the earliest expansion of Seru’s military doctrine.
Arcane resonance pylons were added to detect magical anomalies.
Purity‑screened lookout platforms were integrated to prevent corruption.
Praetorian command nodes were installed to enforce perimeter edicts.
hooks: A resonance pylon detects an unexplained anomaly.
A watchtower reports a purity ward destabilization.
A Praetorian sentry requests assistance with a classified edict.
